review_candidates.title: Mechanical Technical Office Engineer

As a Mechanical Technical Office Engineer, you will be responsible for overseeing and managing mechanical engineering activities related to various construction projects. Your expertise will ensure that mechanical systems are designed, implemented, and maintained to meet industry standards and client requirements.   Ø Responsibilities:   1-     Basics Mechanical Design and Planning: - Your responsibilities will encompass a broad spectrum of tasks, from initial project planning to coordination with various stakeholders and collaborate with project manager to understand client requirements and project objectives to develop mechanical design plans and specifications for projects. Contribute to the development of mechanical designs, including HVAC systems, plumbing, and fire protection, ensuring compliance with relevant codes and standards.   2-     Technical Documentation:   Prepare detailed technical documentation, including drawings, specifications, and calculations. Review and analyse project specifications to ensure accuracy and compliance with design criteria.   3-     Project Documentation: Prepare detailed Mechanical drawings, schematics, and specifications. Review and analyse technical documents, such as blueprints, to ensure accurate project implementation. Maintain comprehensive project documentation throughout all stages, including as-built drawings and technical reports. 4-     Budgeting and Cost Estimation: Assist in the preparation of mechanical project budgets and cost estimates. Provide input on material selection, equipment procurement, and resource allocation to ensure cost-effective solutions without compromising quality and safety. Contribute to the development of project budgets and timelines. Monitor project progress and take proactive measures to address any deviations from the schedule or budget.   5-     Material Procurement and Vendor Management: Coordinate with suppliers and vendors to procure mechanical materials and equipment. Evaluate vendor proposals, negotiate contracts, and ensure timely delivery of materials to meet project timelines.   6-     Coordination and Collaboration: Collaborate with other engineering disciplines to ensure smooth integration of mechanical systems within the overall project. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective communication and collaboration throughout the project lifecycle.   7-     Project Management assist: Assist in project scheduling, progress monitoring, and resource management. Collaborate with project managers to track project milestones, identify potential risks, and propose mitigation strategies.   8-     Procurement skills: Proven experience in procurement processes and vendor management.   Ø Requirements: v Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field. v Proven experience as a Mechanical Technical Office Engineer in the construction industry. v In-depth knowledge of mechanical engineering principles, codes, and standards. v Proficiency in AutoCAD, Hap, Elite and other relevant engineering software. v Participate in studying Tender packaging for (HVAC, Fire Fighting, Plumbing & All Mechanical Works) v Shop-drawing for (HVAC, Fire Fighting, Plumbing & All Mechanical Works) v Able to prepare Tender packaging for design and built projects. v Able to prepare the technical offers. v Participate in reviewing project's contracts. v Studying the project specification, Drawings & BOQ's. v Prepare Budgetary Studies for MEP Projects. v Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. v Team player with the capacity to work collaboratively v Strong organizational and time-management skills. v Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. v Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment. v Attention to detail and strong organizational skills. v Proactive mindset and ability to work under pressure to meet project deadlines. v Knowledge of local mechanical regulations and safety guidelines.

review_candidates.title: Maintenance Technician @Siemens Mobility Egypt
review_candidates.description: Siemens Mobility (SMO) is the world’s leading provider of mobility solutions that enable the efficient, safe, and environmentally friendly transport of people and goods—helping to improve the quality of everyday life for millions worldwide. Motivated by innovation, we develop intelligent solutions for the growing digitalization of the transport sector. Our offerings include rail vehicles, rail automation, road traffic management systems, rail electrification, and services. In Egypt, Siemens Mobility is delivering one of the country’s first high-speed rail system. This landmark project, spanning approximately 2,000 kilometers, will connect 60 cities across Egypt, transforming transportation for both passengers and goods. Participating in this project could be a pivotal milestone in your career and a significant historical achievement for the region. Today, we are recruiting for a Maintenance Technician to join our team in Egypt. This is an excellent career opportunity for professionals looking to join a truly international team in one of the biggest projects of Siemens Mobility. What are my responsibilities? Perform scheduled inspections, servicing and preventive maintenance of Velaro, Desiro and Vectron rolling stock as assigned. Carry out corrective maintenance, fault diagnosis, component replacement and functional checks within assigned authorization. Inspect and maintain relevant mechanical, electrical and onboard vehicle systems using approved procedures. Prepare and use appropriate tools, test equipment, materials, PPE and technical documentation. Follow work orders and Shift Supervisor instructions; promptly escalate defects and unexpected conditions. Record work completed, test results, defects and materials used accurately in the CMMS or approved records. Support vehicle fault response, recovery, testing and return-to-service activities as directed. Apply safe working practices, including vehicle isolation, workshop controls and authorization limits. Participate in toolbox talks, training, competence assessments and improvement activities. What do I need to qualify for this job? Technical diploma or vocational qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Railway Maintenance or a related trade. Practical experience in rolling stock, vehicle or industrial equipment maintenance is preferred. Familiarity with mechanical, electrical or onboard vehicle systems is advantageous. Ability to follow technical instructions and perform inspections, measurements and repairs safely. Experience with maintenance records or CMMS is advantageous. English communication skills sufficient for technical instructions and safety reporting. Practical mechanical and electrical maintenance and basic troubleshooting skills. Ability to read technical drawings, manuals and maintenance checklists. Strong attention to detail, safety awareness and teamwork. Basic computer skills and accurate maintenance recordkeeping. What else do I need to know? As a world leader in developing and producing the most advanced technologies, we improve lives and further human achievements worldwide, while also protecting the climate - all thanks to our employees. Working with us, you have the foundation to develop personally and professionally. We give you the chance to do something significant that benefits society and human progress. We give you the chance to create a difference. At Siemens we are always challenging ourselves to build a better future. We need the most innovative and diverse Digital Minds to develop tomorrow ‘s reality. Find out more about the Digital world of Siemens here: www.siemens.com/careers/digitalminds Diversity at Siemens is our source of creativity and innovation. Having different types of talent and experiences makes us more ambitious and better prepared to respond successfully to the demands of the Society. Therefore, we value the candidates that reflect the Diversity that we enjoy in our Company. Please find more information at www.siemens.com We are looking forward to receiving your online application. Please note: Only complete applications can be considered in the selection process.

review_candidates.title: Lead DevOps Engineer IRC305001
review_candidates.description: Description Our client developes Operation Control Centers for numerous Rail end-users. Requirements We are looking for a Lead DevOps Engineer to help our teams move from small setups to large-scale projects. This role is about more than just tools; it is about building complex systems and helping different teams work together effectively. Experience: At least 6 years working as a DevOps. Key Tools: High-level expertise in Kubernetes, Helm, and Jenkins. CI Knowledge: Strong experience with Continuous Integration, including setting up KPIs and automated code quality checks. Architecture: Familiarity with microservices and how to build systems that scale. Soft Skills: Ability to handle complex team dynamics and lead people through change. Modeling: Ability to create clear diagrams (like UML) to show how technical processes work. Ability and willingness to travel extensively during the first 2–3 months, with the role becoming fully remote afterward. Job responsibilities Build Large Systems: Design and manage the infrastructure as we move from small teams to full-scale projects. Manage Helm: Create and maintain a system for sharing Helm charts across different teams. CI/CD Leadership: Standardize how we build and test code. You will define code quality rules, KPIs, and versioning standards. Pipeline Engineering: Use Jenkins to build and manage complex automation pipelines. Work with People: Navigate “company politics” and help different teams agree on technical standards. Visual Planning: Use UML diagrams to explain how the DevOps systems and workflows work. Deployment: Lead the way in microservices deployment and Continuous Delivery (CD). What we offer Empowering Projects: With 500+ clients spanning diverse industries and domains, we provide an exciting opportunity to contribute to groundbreaking projects that leverage cutting-edge technologies. Comprehensive Benefits: In addition to equitable compensation, we provide a comprehensive benefits package that prioritizes the overall well-being of our consultants. We genuinely care about their health and strive to create a positive work environment. Flexible Opportunities: At GlobalLogic, we prioritize work-life balance by offering flexible opportunities tailored to your lifestyle. Explore relocation and rotation options for diverse cultural and professional experiences in different countries with our company. About GlobalLogic GlobalLogic, a Hitachi Group Company, is a trusted digital engineering partner to the world’s largest and most forward-thinking companies. Since 2000, we’ve been at the forefront of the digital revolution – helping create some of the most innovative and widely used digital products and experiences. Today we continue to collaborate with clients in transforming businesses and redefining industries through intelligent products, platforms, and services.

With more than 1,800 branches nationwide, the bank offers extensive reach and career opportunities across urban and regional locations. It plays a key role in supporting Ethiopia’s economic growth through retail, corporate, and digital banking services. As a large and established institution, Commercial Bank of Ethiopia provides structured training, professional development, and long-term career paths for emerging talent. Role Description The Information Systems Trainee is a full-time, on-site role based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. The trainee will support the bank’s information systems operations by assisting in system monitoring, data management, and basic troubleshooting of IT-related issues. Daily tasks include helping with user support, documenting system processes, updating records in information management platforms, and collaborating with IT and cybersecurity teams to follow security and compliance procedures. The role involves learning and applying bank policies, participating in training sessions, and contributing to small projects that improve system efficiency and reliability. This position is designed to build foundational knowledge in banking information systems and prepare the trainee for more advanced technical roles within the bank. Qualifications Strong analytical skills to interpret data, identify issues, and support problem-solving in information systems. Effective communication skills to interact with technical and non-technical stakeholders and document processes clearly. Foundational knowledge of information management, including organizing, storing, and securing data in structured systems. Basic understanding of information technology concepts, such as networks, databases, and enterprise applications. Awareness of cybersecurity principles, including access control, data protection, and safe system usage practices. Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or final-year student with strong academic standing). Ability to learn new systems quickly, follow procedures, and work accurately with detailed technical information. Integrity, reliability, and a strong commitment to confidentiality and compliance within a regulated banking environment. Team-oriented mindset, willingness to take initiative, and readiness to work on-site in Addis Ababa.

This involves overseeing financial systems and internal controls, and aligning financial operations with corporate goals. The role serves as a business co-pilot, ensuring efficient execution of operations and compliance with financial policies. Success depends on a blend of strong analytical skills, leadership abilities, and comprehensive knowledge of accounting standards, real estate operations, and legal guidelines. What You Will Do: Accounting Policies and Judgements Develop and review accounting policies and procedures specific to the real estate business. Conduct impact assessments of emerging accounting standards and ensure consistent application. Provide expert opinion and interpretation of accounting policies and support complex judgements. Systems, Standards, and Control Framework Implement Al Futtaim financial control framework and standards for the CFC. Monitor compliance with the framework across all CFX business units. Drive process improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency and automation. Lead the development and deployment of systems interfacing with SAP. Support the rationalization of legal entities and SAP entities. Divisional Financial Close and Reporting Framework Review monthly closing procedures and accrual bookings for accuracy. Ensure accuracy and substantiation of all balance sheet accounts. Lead periodic reviews of intercompany reconciliations. Lead CFC consolidation and divisional system consolidation. Coordinate with Regional Finance and Internal Audit on audit assignments. Review and approve financial master data. Financial Control, Governance, and Tax Advisory Oversee FSSC KPIs and SLAs. Support FSSC in onboarding and offboarding entities. Review auditor recommendations and recommend actions. Ensure accuracy and reliability of financial records and reports. Required Skills To Be Successful: Effective management reporting, automation, and accounting system knowledge. Proficiency in EAS/IAS/IFRS. Strong leadership and motivational skills in a complex environment. Ability to communicate financial matters to non-finance professionals clearly. What Qualifies You For The Role: Post-graduate degree in commerce, accounting, or finance. Accounting/Finance qualification (CPA, CA, CMA, ACCA, CFA, CIMA), MBA is a plus. Knowledge of ERP Financial Software, with SAP and Yardi expertise preferred. Minimum of 7 years of experience in Finance and Accounting, with at least 3 years in Real Estate.

Employers offer their people a lease bike, most of them electric, as part of their benefits package, and the client handles the leasing, the dealer network and the service. More than 600,000 employees at around 65,000 companies ride through the programme, supported by 8,000 partner dealers. The business is part of a Dutch family-owned mobility group, and one of Europe's largest automotive financial services groups holds a significant minority stake. It operates across the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, France and Switzerland, and is growing across Europe and the USA. The role The company is bringing its regional platforms together onto one modern platform, running fully cloud-native on AWS with no on-prem. Two roles are open in the infrastructure team that sits underneath every product team, reporting to the Head of Infrastructure. You'll own the AWS organisation, CI/CD and observability, and set the standard for infrastructure delivered by external partners. This suits someone who wants to be the technical authority on infrastructure and is confident telling a vendor their architecture isn't good enough. What you'll be doing Govern and optimise a multi-account AWS Organization: account strategy, IAM, security, compliance and cost Act as the internal technical authority and quality gate for infrastructure delivered by external partners Administer GitLab and design scalable CI/CD pipelines Lead monitoring, logging, tracing and alerting Help the AI team provision and scale ML and LLM workloads What you'll need Several years in a fully cloud-native AWS environment Deep AWS Organizations, multi-account setups, IAM and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform or CDK) Hands-on GitLab administration and enterprise CI/CD Observability tooling such as Datadog, Prometheus and Grafana The confidence to review, challenge and validate vendor architecture Fluent German and English (both required) Nice to have: AWS Solutions Architect or DevOps Engineer certification, GitOps, end-to-end distributed tracing, AWS Bedrock, SageMaker or GPU workloads, experience alongside Big 4 or tier-1 consultancies Location & logistics Remote-first. You can be based in the Netherlands, Germany, Belgium, Austria, France or Sweden, with occasional travel for team events and workshops.

review_candidates.title: Data Delivery Executive
review_candidates.description: We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together. At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. Job Title & Location Job Title: Data Delivery Executive Location: Cairo, Egypt. Hybrid (2-3 days per week in the office) Role Overview: Our Data Production Team is a team that assembles databases. Our Data Delivery Executives are experts in building, validating, and analyzing tendencies while taking in account all the stakeholders’ needs. They also collaborate with local markets. We’re currently looking for entry-level Data Entry Executives to join our Data Production Team. Role Description: As a Data Delivery Executive you’ll be trained to process and validate data, as well as delivering/producing databases to transform our Stakeholders’ requirements into reporting deliverables. If you’re willing to go beyond the obvious, using intelligence, passion, and creativity to inspire new thinking and shape the world we live in, apply for a career that’ll be out of the ordinary and join us! Role Requirements & Capabilities: Key outcomes: Provide analysis and support in data processing procedures based on business software. Process and validate data. Build, validate, and analyse data tendencies taking into account stakeholders’ needs. Deliver and produce databases to translate our stakeholders’ requirements into reporting deliverables. Seeks feedback and applies learnings Collaborate with local markets. What You'll Bring to Numerator Key Capabilities: Knowledge or previous experience in data manipulation is appreciated. Knowledge of basic Query languages. Be able to write, read, comprehend, reason, and perform basic mathematic calculations and data analysis. Experience with Basic and Advanced MS Excel (e.g. Advanced Formulas; Pivot Tables) English professional proficiency - minimum B2 Level is required. With the following qualities… Inquisitive, with critical thinking, and demonstrate a genuine passion for consumer behaviour. Enjoys actively looking for new and more efficient ways of improving processes, raising standards, reducing errors, and overcoming omissions. Is proactive, optimistic, and willing to get involved to achieve the team's goals and objectives. Is highly collaborative and adaptable with the ability to work effectively within different cultural and technical environments. Possesses outstanding communication and interpersonal skills in order to comfortably connect with partners at all levels across the organization and facilitates discussions in a constructive manner.

review_candidates.title: Call Center Agent
review_candidates.description: Company Description Mindbridge is a customer-focused organization dedicated to delivering reliable, high-quality support services across various industries. The company emphasizes clear communication, efficient problem solving, and strong relationships with clients and end users. Team members are encouraged to bring initiative, professionalism, and a commitment to service excellence to their roles. Mindbridge offers opportunities to develop call center expertise and grow within a structured, performance-oriented environment. Role Description This is a full-time, on-site Call Center Agent role based in Nasr City. The Call Center Agent will handle inbound and outbound calls, respond to customer inquiries, and provide accurate information about products and services. Daily responsibilities include resolving issues, documenting interactions in the system, following call scripts and guidelines, and escalating complex cases when needed. The role involves meeting performance targets such as call handling time, quality scores, and customer satisfaction, while maintaining a professional and courteous manner at all times. The agent will collaborate with team members and supervisors to ensure consistent service and continuous improvement. Qualifications Strong verbal communication skills and clear, professional telephone etiquette. Active listening abilities and a customer-focused mindset for handling diverse inquiries. Basic computer literacy, including data entry and navigating call center or CRM systems. Problem-solving skills and the ability to follow procedures while using sound judgment. Ability to work on-site in Nasr City and manage a full-time schedule, including shifts if required. Previous experience in call centers, customer service, or support roles is an advantage. Ability to stay calm under pressure, manage high call volumes, and maintain service quality. High school diploma or equivalent; further education in business, communications, or related fields is a plus. Fluency in spoken and written English and Arabic is preferred, with additional languages considered an asset.
